name: setup-manaflow-ai-basalt-look
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces, after a dense agent-first code editor: theme files for color, flat panes and proportions (Basalt, dark, the default; Basalt Light), settings for the chat's type and column, a sidebar that groups chats under their repository with quiet status dots and hover controls, the changed files card under each turn, a stylesheet of cmux.agentPane.style/1 tokens for the bordered prompt box and the editor's menus, and a customize view for its compact hover card. Remove it and everything you had comes back.

files.customize/cmux-app.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://cmux.dev/schemas/cmux-app/2.json",
  "manifestVersion": 2,
  "id": "local/customize",
  "name": { "en": "Basalt sidebar" },
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Basalt's hover card and sidebar rows: a compact card with the title, then branch and folder lines with their icons, and one-line rows with a quiet status dot.",
  "engines": { "cmux": "^2.0" },
  "repository": "https://github.com/local/customize",
  "runtime": { "main": "main.js" },
  "implements": {
    "cmux.hovercard/1": { "export": "renderCard" },
    "cmux.sidebar.rows/1": { "export": "decorateRows" }
  },
  "scopes": { "workspace:read": "Name the rows to decorate." },
  "activation": ["onInterface:cmux.hovercard/1", "onInterface:cmux.sidebar.rows/1"],
  "files": ["main.js"]
}
files.themes/basalt-light.json:
// Basalt Light: the same agent editor in its light theme. A barely warm #f9f7f8 page, a #f7f7f7
// sidebar behind a 1 pt line, #141414 text with gray steps under it, a deeper steel blue (#3d6db3)
// for Send and focus with white on it, slate-blue links, the bordered prompt box and the same
// pills, proportions and motion as the dark theme.
{
  "name": "Basalt Light",
  "description": "The agent editor, light: #f9f7f8 page, #f7f7f7 sidebar, steel-blue Send, bordered prompt.",

  "appearance.theme": "Builtin Light",
  "appearance.appTheme": "followTerminal",
  // background: the page. foreground: the reply text. selection: a pale steel blue. accent: the
  // dark theme's Run blue taken down until white reads on it.
  "colors": {
    "background": "#f9f7f8",
    "foreground": "#141414",
    "selection": "#cddcf0",
    "accent": "#3d6db3",
    "1": "#c4364c",
    "2": "#2f7a45",
    "3": "#8c600e",
    "4": "#3d6db3",
    "9": "#c4364c",
    "10": "#2f7a45",
    "11": "#8c600e",
    "12": "#4b6983",
    // The terminal palette, whole: the slots above as sampled, the rest at a quiet chroma, each
    // solved in OKLCH over the page (5.2:1, the bright ones 4.7:1, 7 4.8:1, 8 the dim gray 3.4:1),
    // and the cursor in the accent.
    "0": "#141414",
    "5": "#8e538c",
    "6": "#037479",
    "7": "#6a6e75",
    "8": "#82868e",
    "13": "#9f5592",
    "14": "#047b87",
    "15": "#8e9093",
    "cursor": "#3d6db3"
  },
  "appearance.accent": "theme",
  // The terminal face: Menlo at 12 pt, the face and size an editor's terminal opens in on a Mac.
  "terminal.fontFamily": "Menlo",
  "terminal.fontSize": 12,

  "appearance.background": "none",
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "none",
  "browser.omnibar.glass": "off",
  "appearance.fontSmoothing": "antialiased",

  "appearance.chromeStyle": "flat-sidebar-line",
  "appearance.borders": "default",
  "appearance.titleAreaTone": "oneColor",
  "appearance.focusIndicator": "tabs",
  "appearance.density": "comfortable",
  // Pending cmux#46780: a chat's tab is a small rounded pill in the title bar.
  // "appearance.tabShape": "rounded",
  // Pending cmux#46516: the selected sidebar row is a gray fill (#e1e1e1), not the accent.
  // "appearance.selection": "neutral",

  // Proportions: the same as the dark theme (40 pt title bar, 260 pt sidebar, 30 pt rows, 13 pt).
  "appearance.metrics.titlebarHeight": 40,
  "appearance.metrics.sidebarWidth": 260,
  "appearance.metrics.sidebarRowHeight": 30,
  "appearance.metrics.chromeFontSize": 13,
  "appearance.metrics.tabStripHeight": 40,
  "appearance.metrics.tabFontSize": 13,
  "appearance.metrics.tabMaxWidth": 240,
  "appearance.metrics.tabMinActiveWidth": 120,
  "appearance.metrics.tabMinInactiveWidth": 96,
  "appearance.metrics.columnGap": 0,
  "appearance.metrics.dividerThickness": 1,

  // The sidebar: a neutral #f7f7f7, a step under the page, behind a 1 pt line.
  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#f7f7f7",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 1,
  "sidebar.style": "standard",
  "sidebar.border": true,
  "sidebar.borderWidth": 1,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "quiet",

  // The content: the page, with code, diffs and the terminal on the near-white the light editor
  // draws them on.
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#f9f7f8",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.color": "#f9f7f8",
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.color": "#fcfcfc",
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.editor.color": "#fcfcfc",
  "appearance.surfaces.editor.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.diff.color": "#fcfcfc",
  "appearance.surfaces.diff.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.markdown.color": "#f9f7f8",
  "appearance.surfaces.markdown.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.browserChrome.color": "#f9f7f8",
  "appearance.surfaces.browserChrome.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.docks.color": "#f9f7f8",
  "appearance.surfaces.docks.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.splitDivider.color": "#e1e1e1",
  "appearance.surfaces.splitDivider.opacity": 1,

  // Settings and pages: the page, with its grouped cards (#f0eeef) on it.
  "appearance.surfaces.settings.color": "#f9f7f8",
  "appearance.surfaces.settings.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.internalPage.color": "#f9f7f8",
  "appearance.surfaces.internalPage.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.color": "#f9f7f8",
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.home.color": "#f9f7f8",
  "appearance.surfaces.home.opacity": 1,

  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "dot",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.animation": "animated",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.size": 0.8,
  "appearance.statusIndicator.showAgentWorkingOnTabs": true,

  "ui.animationSpeed": "fast",
  "appearance.colorTransition.enabled": true,
  "appearance.colorTransition.curve": "easeOut",
  "appearance.colorTransition.duration": 150,
  "appearance.colorTransition.colorSpace": "oklab",
  "appearance.colorTransition.reduceMotion": "instant"

  // Pending cmux#46861 (layout and proportions): as in the dark theme.
  // "appearance.metrics.sidebarRowHeightWithSubtitle": 44,
  // "appearance.metrics.sidebarRowInset": 8,
  // "appearance.metrics.sidebarRowPadding": 10,
  // "appearance.metrics.sidebarRowGap": 1,
  // "appearance.metrics.toolbarButtonSize": 26,
  // "appearance.metrics.toolbarButtonGap": 6,
  // "appearance.metrics.toolbarButtonCornerRadius": 6,
  // "appearance.metrics.toolbarButtonActiveFill": 0.08,
  // "appearance.metrics.headerDivider": 0,
  // "appearance.metrics.composerPadding": 8,
  // "appearance.metrics.composerMinHeight": 42,
  // "appearance.metrics.spacingScale": 1,
}
